scope: Eight confirmed factory G codes and their labeled source photo groups; buyer questions, not unverified specifications

sports.g-01: G-01 is a genuine XUYI factory model photographed in the clear sports-bottle group with a flip-top drinking lid and straw-style opening. For a distributor choosing an easy-to-explain gym bottle, the source photos are a useful starting point, but they are not a substitute for a confirmed component specification. Ask for a model-labeled assembled sample and check which lid pieces, straw parts and seals are included; any cleaning or leakproof claim requires its own verification. The factory catalog currently does not establish the exact capacity, dimensions, polymer grades, color availability, carton quantity or MOQ for this model. Before producing a branded listing, obtain a drawing, destination-market material documentation and a print proof against the actual clear body. Preserve G-01 on the purchase order so another gallery bottle is not supplied instead.
sports.g-02: G-02 is the confirmed factory code for a photograph-backed group of gradient sports bottles with time-marker graphics. The key buyer decision here is visual rather than a presumed capacity: determine whether the printed reminders remain legible on each selected gradient after adding a private-label logo. Request close-up images of the factory-marked bottle and a physical print sample before approving artwork. Neither the numerical scale nor photographed proportions establish an accurate volume or product height. The model's resin composition, cap configuration, sealing performance, carton packing and currently selectable colorways remain unverified. Ask the supplier to tie a written specifications sheet to G-02 and the approved gallery photograph. Keep the final color sample and packaging terms on file for repeat merchandise orders.
sports.g-05: Factory model G-05 is represented by gradient sports-bottle photographs showing a carry-loop presentation. That photographed loop can guide a merchandising brief, but the photos do not prove its load rating, how it attaches, or that a particular cap and seal come in every variant. For a retailer comparing portable sports bottles, request a real assembled G-05 sample and examine the loop connection, drinking opening, cleaning access and available logo area. Test the chosen gradient with the actual artwork rather than assigning colors based on a neighboring SKU. Capacity, full dimensions, resin grades, packaging counts, MOQ and market-specific compliance evidence have not yet been verified for this model. Demand a signed model-specific data sheet and sample photographs before making performance or inventory claims.
sports.g-09: G-09 is an approved XUYI factory model with its own clear sports-bottle photo group and carry-ring styling. Four catalog images are available, making it practical to request factory confirmation of the same ring and closure assembly from several angles. A promotional buyer should compare how a logo appears through the clear wall and whether the ring obstructs its preferred branding position. Do not infer a tested handle strength, leak resistance or any specific volume solely from the gallery. The current source lacks reliable capacity, exact measurements, material grades, packed carton quantities and production color selection. Obtain an assembled sample identified as G-09 and written confirmation of all detachable parts before preparing quotations. Keep the approved ring detail and photo set associated with this code.
sports.g-10: The G-10 factory model is cataloged through photographs of compact gradient sports bottles with a flip-top presentation. Compact is a visual catalog category here, not a measured height or guaranteed fit for a cup holder or backpack pocket. For a promotional travel range, ask for a dimensioned physical sample, then assess logo placement on the gradient and demonstrate the real opening and cleaning method. Its pictured flip top does not establish a particular gasket, safety certification or spillproof rating. The factory has not yet supplied an approved per-model capacity, polymer specification, carton dimensions, shipping count or complete color offer. Require the specifications to refer expressly to G-10, because similar gallery models may not share tools or accessories. Retain the confirmed print and closure photos.
sports.g-12: G-12 is a confirmed factory model presented as a clear water bottle with a carrying ring. Its own gallery photographs allow prospective wholesale buyers to identify the intended visual style, but they do not establish how the ring is attached or which drinking lid is included in a production batch. A private-label buyer should request an exact-SKU sample, photograph the selected ring and lid configuration and approve logo contrast on the transparent body. The current factory reference leaves capacity, dimensions, component materials, color options, unit packaging and carton quantities unconfirmed. Avoid publishing an assumed volume or carrying-strength rating. Ask the factory for written production drawings and destination-market food-contact evidence before accepting an OEM quote. Preserve the G-12 code and sample sign-off for reorders.

jugs.g-03: G-03 is the verified factory designation for photographed compact water jugs with a carrying handle. The word compact describes their catalog appearance, not an independently measured volume, diameter or packaged footprint. For gym retailers planning a matching jug assortment, request the fully assembled G-03 sample to check handle clearance, real dimensions, opening access and the printed branding area. Inspect actual parts rather than assuming the handle or lid is shared with larger G-series jugs. The current factory record does not confirm capacity, resin composition, lid seals, available colors, master-carton quantities or MOQ. Keep the original gallery images associated with the specific G-03 model, and ask for a written specification plus packing drawing before preparing product labels, freight calculations or any leakproof statement.
jugs.g-04: G-04 identifies a genuine factory photo group of fitness-oriented water jugs shown with a carrying handle. That presentation may suit a gym merchandise assortment, but the source has not verified the vessel's exact holding volume or the handle's loaded performance. Ask for an assembled, water-filled sample and record its measured height, complete dimensions, lid mechanism and location of all removable components. A distributor comparing G-04 with compact G-03 should avoid asserting tooling differences until the factory supplies labeled comparison photographs. Materials, capacity, color stock, carton configuration and market-specific testing have not been confirmed. Before adding an OEM logo or delivery promise, approve the real printing surface and obtain a factory quotation that lists the G-04 model explicitly. Keep measurements tied to that approved sample.
